lines.trans: Are you really going to the team dinner? The CEO said not to go if at all possible.
She asked what that would make her look like if you showed up at the dinner.
That is all the more reason I have to go.
What is the word producers use the most? It is "Cut"!
And what do you cut with? You cut with a knife!
In other words, it means they are the ones holding the handle of the knife.
Especially producers about to start editing are the ones who will happily swing that knife handle around.
At least I need to go smooth things over so they use one more pretty shot and trim out one more unflattering shot.
